title: Concussive punch (talent)
proposed_desc:
A powerful concussive punch that deals {{ctwd|60|150%}} weapon damage to your target. Active Striking Stance further increases the damage. If the punch hits, all targets in a radius of (1 + Combo Points) will take {{ctstd|Str|10|450}} damage, increased by Striking Stance and multiplied by a factor of (0.25 + Combo Points / 5).

The area damage will scale with your Strength, and the radius will increase by 1 per combo point.

Using this talent removes your combo points.

calculations.claim: Weapon damage scales 60–150%; active Striking Stance adds its damage bonus to that multiplier. Area damage scales with Strength from 10 to 450 and is multiplied by both the stance modifier and combo factor.
calculations.derivation: getStrikingStyle returns active Striking Stance damage / 100; getDamage adds it, while getAreaDamage multiplies by 1 + that value. Action then multiplies area damage by 0.25 + combo points / 5.

title: Dark gifts (talent)
proposed_desc:
Your curses bring you dark gifts. Unlocks bonus level (Raw Talent Level) effects (maximum level 4) on all of your curses, allowing you to gain that effect when the power level of your curse reaches that level.

At talent level 5, the luck penalty of cursed effects is reduced to 1.

Talent levels above 5 add bonus power levels to your curses, increasing their effects by {{cts|1|2.5}} levels, scaling with (Talent Level - 5).

calculations.claim: Unlocked curse effect level is raw talent level capped at 4; above talent level 5, bonus curse power scales from 1 to 2.5.
calculations.derivation: Info uses min(4, raw talent level); bonus calls combatTalentScale(max(0, talent level - 5), 1, 2.5). Existing wording preserves both dependencies.

title: Demon seed (talent)
proposed_desc:
Strike a blow with your weapon for {{ctwd|60|160%}} blight damage. If the attack hits, a demonic seed tries to take hold inside your foe and you follow up with a shield strike dealing {{ctwd|60|140%}} damage, with its scaling also affected by Shield Expertise, and dazing your target for 2 to 4 turns.

The seed requires a powerful host to nourish it and can only take hold in creatures that are worth experience and that are not summoned demons.

The chance for the seed to take hold is based on the creature's rank:

Normal: 5%

Elite: 20%

Rare or Unique: 50%

Boss: 100%

When the host dies the seed fills with the vim of the dying creature and turns into a specific [[Demon Seeds|demon seed]] that can be used to summon that demon. If a seed of the same type is already in your inventory or equipment, it instead gains a level when the host was higher level than the seed, and the demon inside regenerates {{cts|10|30%}} health and resurrects if dead.

Higher talent levels allow for more powerful demon types.

Implanting a seed into unique demons, if successful, will always try to grant a seed of that type, if available.

calculations.claim: Weapon strike scales 60–160%; shield damage has 60–140% base endpoints but its talent-level scaling also includes half the Shield Expertise level.
calculations.derivation: combatTalentWeaponDamage uses sqrt((talent level + t2/2) / 5); the shield call supplies Shield Expertise level as t2, so fixed endpoints alone omit a dependency.

calculations.claim: Daze duration is floored, yielding 2–4 turns; seed heal scales 10–30%.
calculations.derivation: getDazeDuration floors combatTalentScale(2.5, 4.5), producing endpoint values 2 and 4; getHeal scales 10 to 30 and info formats it as percent health.

calculations.claim: Existing-seed behavior upgrades a same-type seed when host is higher level and heals/resurrects its demon; it does not state current wiki's superior-level creation restriction.
calculations.derivation: Source description explicitly describes upgrading a lower-level seed and regenerating health/resurrecting the demon.

wiki_only_text_to_preserve: A demonic seed will only be created if you do not already have a seed of this demon/slot of a superior level.

title: Fire breath (talent)
proposed_desc:
You breathe fire in a frontal cone of radius {{cts|5|9}}. Any target caught in the area will take {{ctstd|Str|30|650}} fire damage over 3 turns. If you know Chromatic Fury, this damage also includes {{ctstd|Wil|30|650}} additional fire damage. Half the damage is dealt on talent use and half over the following 3 turns.

The damage will increase with your Strength, and the critical chance is based on your Mental crit rate.

Each point in fire drake talents also increases your fire resistance by 1%.

calculations.claim: Radius scales 5–9; Strength damage scales 30–650; knowing Chromatic Fury adds Will damage with the same endpoints.
calculations.derivation: Source defines radius and conditional damage components; conditional bonus applies only when Chromatic Fury is known.

calculations.claim: Fire Breath deals FIREBURN, which defaults to 50% immediate fire damage and 50% over 3 turns; it does not apply Flameshock.
calculations.derivation: Talent projects FIREBURN with duration 3 and no initial-percentage override. FIREBURN defaults to 50%; Flameshock chance belongs to FIRE_STUN, not FIREBURN.

wiki_only_text_to_preserve: and has a 25% chance of being Flameshocked for 3 turns, stunning them.
''Fire damage is applied 70% on talent use, 30% over next three turns.''

title: Mind blast (talent)
proposed_desc:
Let out a mental cry that shatters the will of your targets within radius 10, dealing {{ctspd|1|100}} darkness damage and confusing ({{cts|20|45%}} to act randomly) them for a duration that scales with your Cunning and talent level, up to 10 turns.

The damage will improve with your spellpower and the duration will improve with your Cunning.

calculations.claim: Confusion chance scales 20–45%; duration is floored and capped at 10 turns although inner combatScale uses a 12-turn endpoint.
calculations.derivation: Duration is min(10, floor(combatScale(talent level + getCun(5), 2, 0, 12, 10))); outer min is not inert, so the existing 2–12 scaling template does not by itself express final capped duration. Chance cap 50 is inert because talent scaling tops at 45.

calculations.claim: Radius is 10 and darkness damage scales with spellpower from 1 to 100.
calculations.derivation: Talent defines radius and spell-damage endpoints, then projects darkness damage and confusion.

title: Warden's focus (talent)
proposed_desc:
Attack the target with either your ranged or melee weapons for 120% weapon damage. Random targeting, such as from {{t|Blink Blade}} and {{t|Warden's Call}}, will focus on this target for a duration that varies with your Paradox and is increased by Extension when active on Warden's Focus.

Attacks against this target gain {{ctl|40%|10|30%}} critical chance and critical strike power while you take {{ctl|40%|10|30%}} less damage from all enemies whose rank is lower than that of your focus target.

calculations.claim: Duration uses Paradox modifier and conditional Extension modifier; fixed 10-turn duration is not source-faithful.
calculations.derivation: getParadoxModifier varies with Paradox and is bounded 0.5–1.5; getExtensionModifier floors the Paradox-adjusted duration, then rounds up after applying Extension power if Extension is active on this talent.

calculations.claim: Weapon damage is fixed at 120%; critical chance, critical power, and damage reduction scale 10–30%, capped at 40%.
calculations.derivation: getDamage returns 1.2; getPower calls combatTalentLimit(t, 40, 10, 30) and info uses that value for all three effects.
